name: actinv

inputs.name: continuation specs
inputs.carried_by: files written by scripts/build_activation_inputs.py, passed to `actinv run`
inputs.unit: irradiation history in seconds; flux in n/cm2/s per group; mass in kg

outputs.name: decay-heat curve of an installation
outputs.format: ACTINV result stream, cached as faris-mct-actinv-points/v0.1
outputs.label: calculated

units: ACTINV results are read in SI (seconds, W, Bq, kg). Conversion to the units a user sees happens in the display layer, never in the stored points file.
cancellation: Every `actinv run` goes through the job runner, so cancelling ends its process group. Points already in the content-addressed points cache stay; a partial run adds none.

failures.mode: the actinv executable or data directory is missing
failures.reported_as: NOT_FOUND in `faris adapters list`; the maintenance result is NOT_EVALUATED
failures.next_step: install ACTINV or pass its path and data directory

failures.mode: ACTINV fails or hits a limit
failures.reported_as: the job status, with the tail of its output (600 characters) in the error
failures.next_step: run the same spec by hand to see why

failures.mode: result stream does not match the request
failures.reported_as: a not-evaluated reason from the result reader
failures.next_step: rerun with the same ACTINV version as the points cache records
